description: Total the open orders per customer. An order's total is the sum over its lines of `quantity` times `price` (in cents). Return a list of records with `customer` and `total` (in cents), one per customer who has at least one open order, sorted by `customer`.

types.Line: Record {sku: String, quantity: Int, price: Int}
types.Order: Record {id: String, customer: String, status: String, lines: List<Line>}

capabilities.description: Lists orders with the given status: open, shipped, or cancelled.
